allowDelegateUnlock.label: Temporary unlock
allowDelegateUnlock.info: Any application running as you can unlock without a password for up to 60 seconds. VGS cannot verify Jarvis or your approval of the step. This gives other apps easier access. Turning this off locks active access. VGS must stay running and responsive: a crash can leave access open, a stall can delay locking, and sleep with Lock before sleep off can extend access.

lock.label: Lock
lock.hint: Another lock screen can prevent VGS from locking the session

temporaryAccess.label: Temporary access
temporaryAccess.info: An allowed request lasts at most 60 seconds while VGS runs and responds. The lock key, inactivity, sleep or turning the permission off can lock sooner. A VGS crash can leave access open; a stall or sleep with Lock before sleep off can extend it.

requirements.purpose: Delays sleep while the session locks
Detects when the computer is about to sleep
Checks how long the computer can wait for the lock
Finds the theme's background image for the lock screen

binds.info: Locks the screen at once and ends temporary access. Your password unlocks it; Temporary unlock also permits password-free access requests.
